entities.title: Trading
entities.summary: Buying and selling goods at the market panel, any item, any order, a quantity.
entities.purpose: Carries out a purchase or a sale at the current system's economy and the pilot's stored market byte, and the most the stepper may offer (deliberate difference 12).
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
Prices, availability and hold space are the market capability's.
